objective: By 2026-11-30, Workspace Control can accept a substantial high-level task, recursively decompose it, route bounded work to deterministic tools, ChatGPT Instant, and subscription Codex as appropriate, execute and recover durably, validate consequential results, synthesize a final result, and account for scarce model usage without paid API fallback or weakened authority.

lanes.name: Reasoning Economy / Codex
lanes.goal: Subscription-only Codex execution, telemetry, economics accounting, calibration, and weekly allowance governor.

lanes.name: Semantic orchestration kernel
lanes.goal: Durable recursive task-tree execution, routing, waits, validation, recovery, and synthesis.

lanes.name: Instant Chat execution
lanes.goal: Production semantic work dispatched to persistent ChatGPT Instant sessions through the accepted low-attention Operator Bridge.

lanes.name: Integrated acceptance
lanes.goal: Research Engine workload proves the complete mixed-executor stack under faults and budget constraints.

requirements.requirement: Durable domain kernel covers WorkItem/ReasoningProcess/Attempt/Lease/Event/WaitCondition/RoutingDecision/ExecutorSession/ValidationResult semantics and fails closed on unknown transitions.
evidence: Production domain kernel and state-machine tests already exist; integrated real-workflow proof remains.

requirements.requirement: Recursive TOO_LARGE decomposition creates child work while preserving inherited constraints, provenance, validator contracts, authority refs, and dependency edges.
evidence: Production WorkContract persists objective plus mandatory constraints, provenance refs, authority refs, validator contracts and output-schema refs.
Semantic Execution #129 proves two-level TOO_LARGE decomposition and deterministic inheritance/merge of all non-droppable parent obligations.
Direct tampering that drops inherited obligations fails global DomainKernel validation.
Independent leaves complete and fan-in resumes only after every child is COMPLETED from passing validation.

requirements.requirement: TOO_LARGE/decomposable and INTRINSICALLY_DIFFICULT/escalation-required work are distinct durable outcomes.
evidence: WorkDisposition is durable and distinguishes UNCLASSIFIED, EXECUTABLE, TOO_LARGE and INTRINSICALLY_DIFFICULT.
TOO_LARGE permits recursive decomposition; INTRINSICALLY_DIFFICULT releases the current lease and forbids decomposition.
A stronger executor may reclaim intrinsically difficult work but contracted effects remain impossible until explicit EXECUTABLE reclassification.
Semantic Execution #129 explicitly validates the distinction.

requirements.requirement: CAS/generation fencing, leases, stale-worker rejection, retry/idempotency and multi-worker recovery work under the production kernel.
evidence: Existing runtime/fault tests cover stale generations, executor loss, duplicate events, crash boundaries and waits.
Recursive dependency-wait recovery preserves generation-fenced WorkContract and waits until both validated leaves complete.

requirements.requirement: WAITING_EXTERNAL consumes zero model reasoning and resumes from durable events rather than LLM polling.
evidence: RuntimeCoordinator event-ledger wait/wake semantics exist and are tested.

requirements.requirement: Worker packets are deterministically compiled from typed durable state; routine packet construction requires no LLM.
evidence: SemanticPacketCompiler canonical hashing was previously validated in isolation.

Coordinated Research Engine read-only slice at workspace-control@34028182aaf1dc56d40cc607f8561c2337e16bf8 used the deterministic packet compiler inside the actual router -> authority -> effect -> validator flow.
Semantic Execution #100 explicitly passed deterministic packet-hash reproducibility in CoordinatedResearchEngineReadOnlySliceTests.

requirements.requirement: Executor registry is model/surface agnostic and supports deterministic, persistent-chat, machine, batch, Codex, frontier, and human profiles.
evidence: Executor profile/router model exists; integrated Instant/Codex adapters remain.
Coordinated slice selected a deterministic repository executor through generic ExecutionRequirement/ExecutorRegistry routing rather than a Research-Engine-specific scheduler branch.

requirements.requirement: Persistent session broker safely reuses/rotates sessions and resumes from durable state after session loss.
evidence: ExecutorSession is durable control state with independent slot/session generation and no authority fields.

Semantic Execution #132 proves healthy persistent reuse, explicit loss/context replacement, stale session-generation rejection, automatic process-recovery fencing and deterministic packet reconstruction into replacement sessions.
Stateless machine executors allocate no session.
PostgreSQL integration proves bound session state survives adapter recreation and is fenced durably on process recovery.

requirements.requirement: Model output may create CandidateAction but cannot mint or widen execution authority; only authority-owned policy may produce executable ActionSpec.
evidence: DomainKernel.compile_action_spec requires exact AuthorityDecision=ALLOW bound to action/process/generation/target.
Coordinated Research Engine slice proved UNKNOWN authority produces no state transition and no repository effect.
Injected generation change after routing/packet planning was fenced before effect execution.

requirements.requirement: Every real effect is idempotent, receipt-bound, independently postcondition-validated, and repairable without duplicate effects.
evidence: EffectReceipt, independent validation, duplicate-effect and crash-after-effect tests exist.

Coordinated slice records EffectReceipt before terminal proposal, independently rereads the exact source, completes only on validator PASS, returns repair-ready on changed bytes, and preserves a single effect for exact duplicate receipt.

evidence: Inert bootstrap workflow and static contracts are validated; promotion is gated on PR #627 lineage.

critical_path_rule: Every implementation item must close or materially advance at least one requirement ID in this matrix. Work that does not map to a requirement is out of the November critical path unless it removes a demonstrated blocker.
completion_rule: November Integrated v0 is complete only when every mandatory requirement is PASS and PROD-03 records PROMOTE_V0.
